cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Multilingual Poster Typography pipeline evaluation (rendering exact FreeType binary glyph masks into Glyph-ByT5/AnyText2/ControlNet for 3D diegetic hero headlines while compositing HarfBuzz-shaped SVG/Canvas vector layers for 12px CJK/RTL/Latin promotional copy and price tags so amortized unit cost c_typo(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_typo = 1.0000x with 0.00% CER across all 17 script tiers u in [0.000, 1.000]) versus naive prompt-only diffusion text rendering (which causes CJK stroke hallucinations and RTL ligature breaks, inflating manual Photoshop re-typesetting spend by 1 + u to 1.2500x at T4, 1.5000x at T8, and 2.0000x at T16 across 16/17 tiers) and 64-glyph stroke quadrature.

good_fit: Global e-commerce promotional posters spanning Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese Kanji, Korean Hangul, Arabic RTL, and Latin scripts

Combining FreeType binary glyph masks + Glyph-ByT5/ControlNet for 3D diegetic hero titles (neon, embossed gold, water droplets) with HarfBuzz SVG/Canvas vector layers for crisp 8px~16px legal/price copy
Exporting multi-layer PSD/SVG templates so regional localization teams can swap 24 languages in seconds without re-running GPU diffusion
not_for: Relying on raw diffusion prompts to render 8px pharmaceutical disclaimers or ingredient tables inside raster pixels
Unverified CJK/Arabic ad publishing without an automated OCR Levenshtein == 0 gate
